name: ses-mcp
description: Amazon SES (messaging): me, send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_ses_access_key_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID
platform_mcp_ses_access_key_id.description: AWS access key id of an IAM principal allowed ses:SendEmail and ses:GetAccount.

platform_mcp_ses_secret_access_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
platform_mcp_ses_secret_access_key.description: The matching AWS secret access key; used only to derive the SigV4 signing key.

platform_mcp_ses_session_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_SESSION_TOKEN
platform_mcp_ses_session_token.description: Session token when the keys are temporary STS credentials (sent as X-Amz-Security-Token).

platform_mcp_ses_region.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_REGION
platform_mcp_ses_region.description: AWS Region of your SES account, e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1 (the endpoint is email.<region>.amazonaws.com).

platform_mcp_ses_from_address.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_FROM_ADDRESS
platform_mcp_ses_from_address.description: Verified sender identity (address or an address on a verified domain) used as FromEmailAddress.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GetAccount (GET /v2/email/account): sending status (SendingEnabled, ProductionAccessEnabled = out of the sandbox), SendQuota {Max24HourSend, MaxSendRate, SentLast24Hours} and enforcement status in this Region.

tools.name: send
tools.description: SendEmail (POST /v2/email/outbound-emails) sends a Simple plain-text message from the configured verified sender to one address; always pass `subject`. In the SES sandbox the recipient must be verified too.
